# My workstyle: PARA

## My words → system concepts
| I say | The system means |
|---|---|
| Project | project record in `10 Projects` |
| Area | a domain/entity lens — NOT a folder; assemble on ask |
| Resource | knowledge + source records |
| Archive | `90 Archive` |

## Speak my language
When filing or reporting, use MY terms first: "filed to your Client Alpha
area" (meaning: tagged to the Client Alpha entity), not "created an
entity-linked note."

## My tags (apply mine verbatim; translate to fields underneath)
| My tag | Also means |
|---|---|
| #urgent | review_due within one week |
| #client-alpha | entity: Client Alpha |
| #idea | note subtype: concept, status: draft |

## My machinery (binding — never rename or move anything these depend on)
- A Dataview dashboard queries the `status` key across `10 Projects` — never
  rename that key or move project files.

## Keep (binding — never propose changing these)
- My daily journal stays in my paper notebook. Don't ask about it again.
- My receipts filing in my own documents folder is mine; never import it.

## Coexistence posture
Side-by-side: this vault serves client work; my old Notion stays alive for
everything personal and is permanently out of scope.
